domains.label: Language syntax
domains.requirement: Every GNU R expression and assignment form normalizes without losing semantics.

domains.label: Value types
domains.requirement: NULL, logical, integer, double, complex, character, raw, list, pairlist, expression, symbol, language, environment, closure, builtin/special, promise, external pointer, weak reference, and S4 shapes.

domains.label: Calls and promises
domains.requirement: Exact/partial/positional matching, missing arguments, dots, defaults, lazy forcing, quote/eval, substitute/match.call, and visibility.

domains.label: Environments
domains.requirement: Lexical lookup, superassignment, locks, active bindings, namespaces, search path, and parent manipulation.

domains.label: Vector semantics
domains.requirement: Coercion, recycling, names/attributes, NA/NaN/Inf, indexing, replacement, and dispatch across every atomic/list type.

domains.label: Conditions
domains.requirement: Errors, warnings, messages, handlers, restarts, calls, traceback, and warning policy.

domains.label: Object systems
domains.requirement: Full S3/group generics, S4 classes/generics/method selection/slots, and compatible external object packages.

domains.label: Core namespaces
domains.requirement: Behavioral coverage for base, stats, methods, utils, grDevices, graphics, and datasets.

domains.label: Numeric runtime
domains.requirement: Complex arithmetic, special functions, linear algebra, FFT, distributions, optimizers, integration, and deterministic tolerances.

domains.label: Data and time
domains.requirement: Factors, frames, arrays, time zones, locales, encodings, connections, serialization, and native data formats.

domains.label: I/O and platform
domains.requirement: Files, URLs, compression, processes, environment variables, capabilities, and browser-safe host adapters.

domains.label: Package execution
domains.requirement: Namespace loading, lazy data, S3/S4 registration, bytecode-equivalent semantics, package resources, and R CMD check behavior.

domains.label: Graphics
domains.requirement: Devices, graphics state, base graphics, colors, fonts, and browser rendering equivalence.
